name: Synapse Connecte
description: Routeur tactique optimisant les flux d'information en temps de combat pour une réactivité maximale des unités alliées.

subject.archetype: Synapse Connecte — Omni-Réseau Uncommon class faille_dimensionnelle

loadout.armor_outfit: Sleek cybernetic combat suit with circuit pathways throughout fabric glowing bright cyan under stress, neural temple implant sparking from combat overload, holographic shield generators deployed on forearms, clean geometric lines contrasting with digital chaos
loadout.arsenal: Neural hacking deck with holographic wrist interface mid-operation showing active code streams, EMP emitter gauntlet crackling with charge creating visible blue arcs, data-spike dagger with glowing edge The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's death ability targeting enemy_on_capture, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Frontline combatant engaged directly with enemy forces with weapon fully committed to the attack. Being captured but reaching back with final curse, focused targeted dark energy flowing from captured body into captor's position as vengeful last act before being taken
attitude.emotion: Battle-tested confidence — knowing skills will carry through the engagement

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Neon Cyan
palette_names.role: primary_accent — data streams and arcing energy bolts

palette_names.name: Electric Blue
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — arc lightning and holographic displays

palette_names.name: Stark White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — interface glare and explosive sparks

color_and_light.lighting_setup: oxidized copper frame with faction insignia embossed on each corner, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Slightly low angle waist-up shot with environmental action visible in background, motion blur on debris and effects

scenography.setting: Cyber warfare zone with holographic displays shattering and glitching during battle, digital fortifications crumbling under enemy ICE attacks with visible code deterioration, server towers toppling and sparking, electric storms rippling through infrastructure
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Malevolent curse energy crawling up captor from point of contact, visible dark tendrils of corruption spreading across their body and position with malignant effect, Ground around captor darkening and dying as curse takes hold, corruption spreading from contact point showing the price of victory, Data streams arcing between floating terminals like electric whip lashes, holographic shields shattering into cascading pixel fragments dissolving mid-air, EMP waves visible as expanding blue rings distorting everything, server racks exploding in showers of sparks and circuit boards, electric arcs grounding through coolant puddles creating branching lightning
